checks.text: The page displays the heading "Whiteboard" and the text "Ready to draw" in the empty state area.
Clicking the button labelled "Brush" in the toolbar shows the text "Brush active" in the status bar; clicking the button labelled "Eraser" changes the status bar text to "Eraser active".

Selecting the option "Red" in the select labelled "Color" and the option "10px" in the select labelled "Size", then drawing a stroke on the canvas, results in the status bar showing "Stroke added: Red, 10px".

Clicking the button labelled "Add layer" creates a new list item in the layers panel containing the text "Layer 2"; clicking the button labelled "Delete Layer 2" removes that item, leaving only "Layer 1" visible.

Clicking the button labelled "Undo" after drawing a stroke removes the last stroke from the canvas and updates the status bar to "Undo: stroke removed"; clicking "Redo" restores the stroke and updates the status bar to "Redo: stroke restored".
Clicking the button labelled "Export PNG" triggers a download of a file named "whiteboard.png" and displays the toast message "PNG exported successfully".
Clicking the button labelled "Clear canvas" removes all strokes from the active layer and displays the toast message "Canvas cleared"; the status bar returns to "Ready to draw".
Typing "Zoom in" in the input field labelled "Zoom level" and pressing Enter changes the canvas zoom to 125% and updates the text in the zoom indicator to "125%".
Reload keeps the drawing state: after drawing a stroke and reloading the page, the canvas still displays the stroke and the status bar shows "Restored: 1 stroke".
